Finding.description:
One distinct difference of a run: the same change, wherever it was seen.

A field whose type changed shows up in every case that returns it.
Grouping is done by the database, so a run with a hundred thousand
differences still yields a short list.

SideResult.description:
What happened when one step was sent to one API.

Exactly one of three things: a response came back, the request failed
(`error`), or it was never sent (`skipped`).

StepComparison.description: The outcome of comparing the old and new responses to one request.

UnorderedRule.description:
Compare the array at `path` without regard to element order.

With `key`, elements are paired by that field and then compared field by
field. Without it, elements are paired only when they are entirely equal.
UnorderedRule.title: UnorderedRule
